lenses.name: Electricity use
lenses.description: Total 2024 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per department resident. Department-level totals aggregate residential and economic activity; they are not household-only consumption. Enedis does not serve Corsica and some local-distribution areas, so low values there reflect network coverage as well as use.

lenses.name: Residential electricity
lenses.description: Residential 2024 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per department resident. Enedis does not serve Corsica and some local-distribution areas, so low values there reflect network coverage as well as use.

lenses.name: Tertiary electricity
lenses.description: Tertiary-sector 2024 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per department resident. Values reflect where economic activity is located, not household use. Enedis does not serve Corsica and some local-distribution areas, so low values there reflect network coverage as well as use.

lenses.name: Industrial electricity
lenses.description: Industrial 2024 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per department resident. Values reflect where industrial load is located. Enedis does not serve Corsica and some local-distribution areas, so low values there reflect network coverage as well as use.

lenses.name: Agricultural electricity
lenses.description: Agricultural 2024 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per department resident. Values reflect where metered agricultural load is located. Enedis does not serve Corsica and some local-distribution areas, so low values there reflect network coverage as well as use.
